_comment: RRM grant row: the DATA-SCOPE gate. This is what turns Beacon's asserted profile.groups=['beacon-agents'] into actual permissions. Namespace-SCOPED (resourceId = the pharmacy namespace UUID), NOT GLOBAL — Beacon should reach only the one namespace, unlike the Group::Admin GLOBAL platform-admin row. Mirrors the live Group::Admin attribute shape exactly (PK/SK + principalKey/resourceRoleKey GSI keys + namespaceKey). Role 'data-analyst' = read/query, not steward/owner. Written to coa-dev-resource-role-mappings via PutItem (reversible). The example columnDenylist shows how to strip patient-identifying columns from Beacon's reads — edit/remove per the real pharmacy schema once seeded.
_optional_data_restrictions_note: To constrain Beacon's reads, add attributes to the item above, e.g. columnDenylist = { 'M': { '<table>': { 'L': [ {'S':'patient_name'}, {'S':'mrn'} ] } } } and/or allowedMetrics = { 'L': [ {'S':'<metric-id>'} ] }. Omitted here because the pharmacy namespace has no sources/schema seeded yet (sourceCount=0), so there are no real table/column names to deny.
